name: github-repo-directory-download
title: GitHub Repo Directory Download
description: Download specific folders or files from public or private GitHub repositories directly to your machine.
author: SandeepBaskaran

preferences.name: githubToken
preferences.title: GitHub Personal Access Token
preferences.description: Required for downloading from private repositories. Generate one at github.com/settings/tokens (Needs 'repo' scope).

preferences.name: autoLoadUrl
preferences.label: Auto-load URL from Clipboard
preferences.title: Clipboard
preferences.description: Automatically fill the GitHub URL field if a valid URL is found in the clipboard.

commands.name: download-directory
commands.title: Download Directory
commands.description: Download a specific folder from a GitHub repository

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
